blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Non-invasive brain-to-text seeks to recover language from brain activity without surgery. A central challenge is turning learned brain-language representations into accurate word predictions. We present MEG2text, a decoding system that combines corrected training and evaluation, brain-text alignment, a class-balanced word readout, and target-word language-model fusion. On LibriBrain100's word-ranking task, MEG2text reaches 64.12% mean Top-10 balanced accuracy, improving on published MEG-XL by 16.92 percentage points across four corpora, with gains on each corpus. Controlled comparisons show that both implementation corrections and a learned readout contribute to this improvement. Candidate-level analysis reveals that some words receive informative scores yet consistently lose to competing candidates, while an identical-feature comparison shows that learning the classification rule improves decoding without changing the representation. These findings identify the decoding rule as a consequential part of non-invasive brain-to-text and show how system improvements can make better use of aligned neural features.
blocks.zh: 非侵入性脑到文字寻求从脑活中恢复语言而无需手术. 一项核心挑战是将所学的脑语言表述转化为准确的字词预测. 我们介绍MEG2text,一种将校正的训练和评价,脑文本对齐,班级平衡的单词读取,以及目标词语言模型聚变相结合的解码系统. 在LibriBrain100的文字排行任务上,MEG2text达到了64.12%的TOP-10平衡精度,在公布的MEG-XL上提高了16.92个百分点,在4个Corpora上,每件都取得了收益. 控制下的比较表明,实施纠正和学习的宣读都有助于这一改进。 候选人一级的分析显示,有些词获得信息性分数,但一直输给竞争对手,而一个相同特点的比较表明,学习分类规则可以改善编解码,而不会改变代表性。 这些发现将解码规则确定为非侵入性脑到文字的必然部分,并显示系统改进如何能更好地利用对齐神经特征.

blocks.en: Recovering language from non-invasive brain recordings could help restore communication for people with severe paralysis. Progress toward this goal requires both learning useful neural representations and converting them into accurate language predictions. MEG provides millisecond-resolution measurements of brain activity without surgery, and LibriBrain100 ( Mantegna et al., 2026 ) makes more than one hundred hours of speech-listening recordings available for studying this problem. Its word-decoding benchmark offers a concrete test: given a neural event at a known word onset, rank the corresponding word among fifty candidates.
blocks.zh: 从非侵入性脑录相中恢复语言可以帮助重度瘫痪者恢复交流. 要在实现这一目标方面取得进展,既需要学习有用的神经表达,也需要将其转化为准确的语言预测. MEG提供毫秒分辨的脑活性测量,LibriBrain100(Mantegna等,2026年)为研究这个问题提供了一百多小时的语音录音. 它的"词解码基准"提供了一个具体的测试:在已知的"词"发作时的神经事件,将相应的"词"排在50名候选人中.

blocks.en: The MEG-XL baseline ( Jayalath and Parker Jones, 2026a ) approaches this task by aligning neural features with frozen T5 word embeddings ( Raffel et al., 2020 ) and ranking words by their similarity to those embeddings. This connects representation learning and prediction through a single scoring rule. Yet a score that distinguishes a word’s own events from other events can still remain below competing words’ scores. We observe exactly this pattern in a retrained MEG-XL model: some words have informative scores but never enter the top ten. The observation raises a broader question for decoding systems: how can we turn the information available after alignment into more accurate word predictions?
blocks.zh: MEG-XL基线(Jayalath和Parker Jones,2026a)通过将神经特征与被冻结的T5词嵌入(Raffel等,2020年)相配合来进行这项工作,并按其与那些嵌入的相似性来排列词. 这通过单一打分规则将表现学习和预测联系起来. 但将一个字本身的事件与其他事件区分开来, 我们在重新训练的MEG-XL模型中完全观察到这个模式:有些单词有信息分数,但从未进入前十名. 观察对解码系统提出了更广泛的问题:我们如何将调整后可获得的信息转化为更准确的词预测?

blocks.en: MEG2text addresses this question across the decoding pipeline (Figure 1 ). We first correct defects in the released training and evaluation code so that the alignment model is trained and evaluated as intended. We then retain the learned representation and fit a class-balanced classifier that learns how candidate words compete. Finally, a frozen T5 decoder, conditioned on the target event through learned adapters, supplies complementary word scores. This design preserves brain–text alignment while allowing the prediction rule to adapt to the word-decoding task.
blocks.zh: MEG2text在解码管道中解决了这个问题(图1). 我们首先纠正了已发布的培训和评价守则中的缺陷,以便按照计划对调整模式进行培训和评价。 然后,我们保留所学得的代表性,并适合一个班级平衡的分类人员,学习候选词如何竞争。 最后,一个被冷冻的T5解码器通过学习的适配器以目标事件为条件,提供互补的单词分数. 这种设计保留了大脑-文本对齐,同时允许预测规则适应词解码任务.

blocks.en: We evaluate the complete system, isolate implementation and readout improvements through controlled comparisons, and diagnose which words gain or lose correct predictions. Our contributions are: • A stronger complete MEG decoding system. MEG2text combines implementation repairs, aligned neural features, learned classification and target-word T5 fusion. It improves performance across all four benchmark corpora, with controlled experiments measuring the gains from specific stages (Section 5.1 ). • Evidence that similarity scoring leaves useful information untapped. Learning a class-balanced readout on identical frozen features improves every corpus on both validation and test. This comparison establishes that better word predictions are possible without changing the representation, while retaining a linear scoring rule (Section 5.2 ). • A diagnostic distinction between separation and retrieval. Word-level analysis identifies informative scores that fail in the shared candidate ranking. Comparing readouts shows how recovering missed words trades off against predictions elsewhere in the vocabulary, giving a way to diagnose decoding failures beyond aggregate accuracy (Sections 5.3 – 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价整个系统,通过有控制的比较来孤立执行和读取改进,并判断哪些词获得或失去正确的预测。 我们的贡献是:加强完整的MEG编解码系统。 MEG2text结合了执行修复,对齐的神经特征,所学的分类以及目标词T5聚变. 它提高了所有四个基准公司的业绩,并有控制的实验测量特定阶段的收益(第5.1节)。 有证据表明,相似性评分使有用的信息得不到利用。 对相同的冷冻特征进行班级平衡读取,在验证和测试上改进了每套课程。 这种比较确定,在不改变表述的情况下,可以作出更好的字数预测,同时保留线性评分规则(第5.2节)。 诊断区分分离与取回. 词层分析确定在共享候选人排名中失败的信息分数. 比较读取显示,恢复漏取的字句如何与词汇中其他地方的预测相取舍取出,从而提供了一种方法来诊断超出总精度的解码失败(第5.3至5.4节 ) 。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Contrastive alignment enables identification of heard speech by connecting non-invasive brain recordings to pretrained speech representations ( Défossez et al., 2023 ) . MEG-XL ( Jayalath and Parker Jones, 2026a ) learns long-context MEG representations, and its LibriBrain100 baseline ( Mantegna et al., 2026 ) adapts them to word classification through alignment with T5 embeddings ( Raffel et al., 2020 ) using a SigLIP-style loss ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) . We retain this representation-learning approach and examine the complete path from its implementation to the rule used for word prediction.
blocks.zh: 相矛盾的对接使得通过将非侵入性大脑录音连接到预先训练的语音表达(Défossez等,2023年)来识别听力的语音. MEG-XL(Jayalath和Parker Jones,2026a)学习了长文本的MEG表达,而它的LibriBrain100基线(Mantegna等,2026年)通过与T5嵌入(Raffel等,2020年)的对接,使其适应了文字分类,使用SigLIP风格的丢失(Zhai等,2023年). 我们保留这种代表性学习方法,并审查从执行到文字预测规则的完整路径。

blocks.en: Linear probes test how well frozen representations support classification ( Alain and Bengio, 2016 ) . CLIP compares fitted linear classifiers with predictions based on text embeddings ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , and long-tailed recognition separates representation learning from classifier fitting ( Kang et al., 2020 ) . These precedents motivate our controlled comparison. The MEG encoder already receives word supervision during alignment, so our question is whether fitting the downstream decision rule improves predictions from that supervised representation. Word-level diagnostics then examine what changes in the resulting ranking.
blocks.zh: 线性探测器测试了冰冻表达法如何支持分类(Alain and Bengio, 2016.). CLIP将已安装的线性分解器与基于文本嵌入的预测相比较(Radford等,2021年),而长尾识别则将代表学习与分解器相分离(Kang等,2020年). 这些先例促使我们进行有控制的比较。 MEG编码器在对齐时已经接收到单词监督,所以我们的问题是,按照下游决定规则是否改进了对受监督代表的预测. 词层诊断然后检查由此而来排名的变化.

blocks.en: In high-dimensional nearest-neighbour retrieval, some targets become hubs that are returned much more often than others ( Radovanović et al., 2010 ) . This imbalance has motivated neighbourhood-based score corrections for zero-shot retrieval ( Dinu et al., 2015 ; Conneau et al., 2018 ; Smith et al., 2017 ) ; logit adjustment addresses class-prior effects in long-tailed classification ( Menon et al., 2021 ) . The uneven candidate frequencies we observe on LibriBrain100 motivate testing both families of correction. They provide comparisons for determining how much can be recovered by adjusting similarity scores while retaining the text embeddings as classifier weights.
blocks.zh: 在近邻高维度检索中,一些目标成为中心,比其他目标更经常地返回(Radovanović等,2010年)。 这种不平衡促使了邻里基于零发回取的分数校正(Dinu等,2015年;Conneau等,2018年;Smith等,2017年;logit调整解决了长尾分类中的分数先行效应(Menon等,2021年). 我们在LibriBrain100上观察到的不均匀的候选频率,促使我们测试两个矫正家庭。 它们提供了比较,以确定通过调整相似性分数,同时保留文本嵌入为分级权重,可以回收多少.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We use the public LibriBrain100 training release for Subjects 0--32 and the official Subject 0 validation and test partitions for Sherlock, TIMIT, MOCHA-TIMIT and TheMoth. 1 1 1 The dataset is distributed as pnpl/LibriBrain2 : https://huggingface.co/datasets/pnpl/LibriBrain2 . Encoder alignment uses 15,613 groups comprising 780,650 events; Subject 0 contributes 95.87% of these events. Readout fitting uses the 314,371 training events whose labels belong to the fifty-word candidate vocabulary; events outside that vocabulary contribute to alignment but are excluded from readout fitting. Validation and test contain 3,149 and 3,172 fixed-vocabulary events, respectively, covering all fifty word classes. Appendix C gives the corpus-level counts.

blocks.en: We report the equal-weight four-corpus mean of Top-10 balanced accuracy. Within each corpus, we compute the fraction of correct top-ten predictions separately for each word class and average over the classes present. A uniform random ranking has expected accuracy of 20%. For diagnostics, a candidate is nominated whenever it enters an event’s top ten; its nomination rate is the fraction of pooled test events where this occurs, irrespective of the true word. We compare with published joint-training MEG-XL scores ( Mantegna et al., 2026 ) , whose four-corpus mean is 47.20% (Table 1 ), using the same official partitions, candidate list and metric. All differences are computed before rounding. A separate matched implementation control, described in Appendix B , measures the effect of the repairs.

blocks.en: We initialize the encoder from the official MEG-XL V2 pretrained weights, freeze the signal tokenizer, and train the encoder, word head and loss parameters. The original alignment objective uses other words in each group as negatives and masks repeated words. We repair two defects in the released implementation: evaluation left dropout active, and optimization and checkpoint saving omitted the loss temperature and bias. All fitted readouts use the epoch-2 model selected on validation data after two epochs of training (checkpoint A). Archived diagnostic scores use the epoch-3 model selected after continuing the run to six epochs (checkpoint B).
blocks.zh: 我们从官方的MEG-XL V2预训重量上初始化了编码器,冻结了信号指示器,并训练了编码器,单词头和损失参数. 最初的对接目标使用每组中的其他单词作为负和口罩重复单词. 我们修复了发布执行中的两个缺陷:评价导致辍学现象活跃;优化和检查站储蓄省去了损失温度和偏差。 所有装配的读取器都使用两个训练时段(A检查点)后在验证数据上选择的去向-2模型. 存档的诊断分数使用在继续跑到6个时段(B检查点)后所选择的去向-3模型.

blocks.en: We estimate sampling uncertainty by resampling sentences within each corpus, using 10,000 cluster-bootstrap replicates ( Efron, 1979 ) . Every method is evaluated on the same resampled sentences, giving paired score differences. We report 95% basic bootstrap intervals; Appendix C defines these intervals and provides the percentile alternatives. The identical-feature comparison uses checkpoint A, whose similarity score is 60.21%. The saved event-level comparisons and diagnostics use fitted readouts on checkpoint A and similarity scoring on checkpoint B, whose mean is 59.98%.

blocks.en: On identical frozen features, the cross-entropy readout raises the four-corpus test mean from 60.21% to 63.98% (Table 2 ). Every corpus improves on both validation and test. Because the encoder outputs are unchanged, this comparison attributes the gain to learning the word-classification rule and demonstrates useful information left untapped by similarity scoring.

blocks.en: Fitting a classifier is only part of the improvement: the choice of loss also matters in this comparison. With features and class weights fixed, cross-entropy exceeds squared loss by 2.77 test points (paired 95% interval [ + 0.83 , + 4.43 ] [+0.83,+4.43] ) and scores higher on validation. Squared loss improves over similarity scoring in two corpora and falls below it in the other two (Table 2 ). The objective that explicitly compares candidate scores produces the more consistent improvement.

Squared loss lowers Top-1 by 4.23 points. Thus, the improved Top-10 result reflects better inclusion of the true word among leading candidates, with little change in the cross-entropy readout’s Top-1 score.

blocks.en: 5.3 Per-class analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 按类别分析

blocks.en: Table 4: Diagnosing candidate competition through score corrections and fitted readouts. Six corrections retain the text embeddings as classifier weights; an in-sample reference and two learned readouts complete the comparison. Mean is four-corpus Top-10 balanced accuracy (%). Hit rates average the pooled per-class Top-10 rates separately for the six zero-hit words and the remaining 44. Nomination rates show the minimum and maximum across candidates. Cross-fitted corrections are fitted on half of the test sentences and evaluated on the other half, then averaged over random splits; fitting and selection details appear in Appendix C .

blocks.en: Similarity scoring consistently misses six words that account for 943 of the 3,172 test events. Five— the , of , we , for and she —never enter the top ten; i enters three times, but never when it is correct. At the other extreme, were is nominated on 43.38% of all events (Figure 2 b, Table 4 ). The missed words include the first, third and fourth most frequent training candidates, while other common words such as and , to and a have high hit rates. These zero-hit classes therefore reveal a systematic ranking imbalance that affects frequently observed words as well as less common ones.
blocks.zh: 相似性评分一直漏出6个字,占了3,172个测试事件中的943个. 5,即,我们,为和她——从来没有进入前十;我进入了3次,但在正确的时候从来没有. 在另一个极端,在所有活动中,43.38%被提名(图2b,表4)。 遗漏的词包括第一、第三和第四个最经常接受培训的候选人,而其他常见的词如和(或)和(或)和(或)的点击率高。 因此,这些受零打击的类别显示出系统性的排名不平衡,影响到经常观察到的词语以及不太常见的词语。

blocks.en: One-versus-rest AUROC distinguishes missed predictions from uninformative scores by testing whether a candidate’s score is higher on its own events than on other events. Similarity scores for the and of show weak separation, but we and she reach AUROCs of 0.75 and 0.72 despite never entering the top ten (Figure 2 c). Their scores contain information about the correct class, yet competing words outrank them. A zero hit rate can thus hide two different problems: weak class separation and a scoring rule that fails to turn available separation into retrieval.
blocks.zh: One-rest AUROC通过测试考生本身的得分是否高于其他事件的得分,将错失的预测与非入门分区分开来. 相似性得分和显示弱分,但我们和她虽然从未进入前十名(图2 c),却达到了0.75和0.72的AUROCs. 他们的分数包含关于正确班级的信息,然而相竞争的单词排在他们之后. 因此,零命中率可以隐藏两个不同的问题:弱类分离和打分规则未能将可用的分离转化为取回.

blocks.en: The fitted cross-entropy readout nominates every candidate. In the archived-score comparison, the six zero-hit classes reach hit rates of 68–83% (Figure 2 d) and account for 734 of the 837 newly correct events. Most recovered hits therefore come from words that similarity scoring consistently missed.
blocks.zh: 适合的交叉读取提名每个候选人。 在存档-分数比较中,6个零重级的命中率达到68–83%(图2d)并占了837个新正确事件的734个. 因此,大多数恢复的点击来自类似评分一直被忽略的词语。

blocks.en: In this diagnostic comparison, the six recovered classes contribute + 8.57 +8.57 points to the four-corpus mean, while changes in the remaining 44 contribute − 4.57 -4.57 (Appendix C ). The net improvement therefore comes from recovering persistently missed words at a smaller cost elsewhere in the vocabulary. Table 9 reports the per-word separation and hit rates, showing which words benefit and which lose correct predictions.
blocks.zh: 在这种诊断比较中,六个恢复的班级贡献了+8.57+8.57的分数,指向了四体的平均值,而其余44个班级的变化贡献了−4.57-4.57 (附录C.). 因此,净改善来自在词汇的其他地方以更小的代价收回长期被忽略的文字。 表9报告按字数分列的离职率和点击率,显示哪些字受益而哪些字丢失了正确的预测.

blocks.en: Recovering the zero-hit words alone does not explain why cross-entropy is the better readout. Squared loss also nominates every word and gives the six classes a mean hit rate of 69.9%, with class separation comparable to cross-entropy (Table 4 ). The difference lies in predictions elsewhere: on identical features, cross-entropy correctly ranks 167 events that squared loss misses, while the reverse occurs for 84 events. Its contribution to balanced accuracy improves for 29 classes and declines for 11. A useful readout must therefore recover neglected words while preserving correct rankings across the rest of the vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 单是恢复"零打"字并不能解释为什么"交叉通"读取效果更好. 平分损失还提名了每个字,使这六个类别的平均命中率达到69.9%,班级的分出率可相上下(表4). 不同之处在于别处的预测:在相同的特征上,交叉纵横正确排列了167个平方损失错失的事件,而相反的是84个事件. 它对平衡准确性的贡献提高了29个类别,下降了11个类别。 因此,一个有用的读出必须收回被忽略的词,同时保留其他词汇的正确排名.

blocks.en: Score corrections provide a complementary test of this ranking problem. Six evaluated corrections retain the text embeddings as weights and score below the learned readout (Table 4 ). The zero-initialized in-sample offset reference reaches a similar aggregate score while still missing several zero-hit words; another initialization gives all six positive hit rates (Appendix C ). These results show why aggregate accuracy and word-level recovery should be examined together. The appendix gives the corrections’ fitting rules, including the use of test labels for diagnostic fitting and selection.
blocks.zh: 分数校正是对这一排名问题的补充测试。 6项经评价的更正保留了嵌入文字作为权重和分数,低于所学到的读出(表4)。 零初始化的倒数倒数引用达到相近的总分,同时仍然缺少几个零重字;另一个初始化给出了所有六个正命中率(Appendix C. 这些结果表明,为什么应一并审查总的准确度和词级恢复。 附录规定了校正的适当规则,包括使用测试标签进行诊断和选择。

blocks.en: 5.4 Alternative readouts and the T5 branch
blocks.zh: 5.4 (中文(简体) ). 替代读取和 T5 分支

blocks.en: Table 5: Nine alternative readouts on checkpoint A (four-corpus test mean, %). The first seven add a learned term to the frozen scores of the cross-entropy readout; the last two are fitted with a squared loss on other features. Δ \Delta is the difference from the linear readout with the same loss, with its paired 95% interval where per-event scores were saved.
blocks.zh: 表5:A检查站的9个替代读取(四人单位测试,百分比)。 前7个在交叉通取读取的被冻结分数中再加一个有学问的名词;后2个被安装在其他特征上有平方损失. \\ Delta 表示与损失相同的线性读取的相差,其成对间隔为95%,每个事件得分被保存.

blocks.en: After establishing the linear readout, we test whether additional transformations improve its predictions. Seven alternatives add nonlinear, contextual, cross-layer or corpus-specific corrections to its frozen scores (Table 5 ). None has a higher test mean than linear cross-entropy. For the three with saved event-level predictions, paired intervals include zero and their upper bounds are below 1.2 points. The gated cross-layer correction improves validation accuracy but scores lower on test. Within these tested designs, additional readout capacity does not provide a consistent improvement.
blocks.zh: 在建立线性读取后,我们测试额外变换是否改进其预测. 7个备选方案在其被冻结的分数中增加了非线性、上下文、跨层或针对具体实体的校正(表5)。 没有一个测试的平均值高于线性交叉性。 对于有被保存的事件级别预测的3个,对接间隔包括0个,而它们的上界分低于1.2分. 入门的跨层校正提高了校正精度,但在测试中得分较低. 在这些经过测试的设计中,额外的读出能力并不能提供连贯的改进.

blocks.en: The remaining two alternatives change the input features of the squared-loss readout. Using intermediate word-head features after the GELU gives similar accuracy to using the final representation. A kernel feature map improves the squared-loss result, but its test mean remains below linear cross-entropy. In these comparisons, changing the fitting objective is more effective than either feature extension.
blocks.zh: 其余两种替代品改变了平方损耗读取的输入特性. 在GELU后使用中间的单词头特征,给使用最终表示提供了类似的准确性. 内核特征图可以改善平方损耗结果,但其测试平均值仍然低于线性交叉收缩. 在这些比较中,改变合适的目标比扩展特征更有效。

blocks.en: The T5 branch tests whether a pretrained decoder adds useful predictions to the learned readout. Target-only memory substantially outperforms group memory when each branch predicts words alone, on both validation and test, but their fused results are close (Table 8 , Appendix A ). Target-only fusion adds 0.14 points to the linear readout, bringing MEG2text to 64.12%. Thus, the large standalone advantage translates into only a small advantage after fusion: the relevant system-level comparison is the improvement beyond the existing classifier.
blocks.zh: T5分支测试预训解码器是否为所学的读取增加了有用的预测. 当每个分支在验证和测试中单独预测单词时,只针对的内存会大大地超过组内存,但其被熔化的结果是接近的(表8,附录A.). 只针对聚变在线性读出后会增加0.14分,使MEG2text达到64.12%. 因此,巨大的独立优势只转化为聚变后的一个小优势:相关的系统层面比较是超越了现有分类器的改进.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The system gain reflects improvements in both learning and using aligned features. The implementation control establishes a gain from correcting training and evaluation; the identical-feature comparison shows that the resulting representation supports better predictions than its original similarity scores achieve. Evaluating an aligned encoder through a single scoring rule can therefore understate its value for word decoding.
blocks.zh: 系统增益反映出学习和使用一致特性方面的改进。 实施控制确立了从纠正培训和评价中获得的好处;同样的特征比较表明,由此产生的表述支持比其最初的相似性分数更好的预测。 因此,通过单一的评分规则来评价一个对齐的编码器可以低估其对词解码值.

blocks.en: Word-level diagnostics help locate this gap. Informative scores with no nominations identify candidates whose cross-candidate ranking deserves investigation before concluding that their representation lacks useful information. The identical-feature readout comparison separately demonstrates that predictions can improve while the encoder remains fixed.
blocks.zh: 语言层面的诊断有助于找到这一差距。 在认定候选人的任职情况缺乏有用信息之前,没有提名的知情者得分确定候选人的跨候选人排名值得调查。 同质读出比较分别显示,在编码器保持固定的同时,预测可以改进.

blocks.en: Both fitted objectives recover the six zero-hit words, but cross-entropy better balances recovered and lost predictions. The tested extensions do not surpass this linear readout, and T5 adds a small gain after fusion. These results favor establishing a class-balanced decision rule first, then judging extensions by their net contribution to the complete system.
blocks.zh: 两个配上的目标都恢复了6个零重击的单词,但交叉纵横的平衡较好地恢复了和丢失了的预测. 被测试的扩展不会超过这个线性读取,而T5在聚变后会增加一个小增益. 这些结果有利于首先确立一个等级平衡的决定规则,然后根据其对整个系统的净贡献来判断延期。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: The study uses one training seed and test-informed development: the full system was selected by test mean among 20 variants, and some score corrections were fitted or tuned on test labels. Bootstrap intervals quantify test-sampling uncertainty, excluding retraining and between-session variation. The benchmark evaluates Subject 0 with known word onsets and fifty candidates; this subject contributes about 96% of training events. Overlapping windows expose timing cues ( Jayalath and Parker Jones, 2026b ) , some TIMIT windows share samples across partitions, and possible training exposure to MOCHA-TIMIT test sentences remains unverified. Generalization to unseen participants and open-vocabulary decoding therefore requires separate evaluation. The published-baseline comparison also includes differences in pretraining, public-data coverage and training configuration, while the original paper leaves the exact checkpoint and launch configuration unspecified. Our matched control measures the two repairs jointly with one seeded export; the residual gap to the published baseline remains unattributed. The 3.77-point readout gain holds features fixed, but has no computed paired interval. The + 4.00 +4.00 interval and six-class diagnostic use different checkpoints and do not isolate the readout’s effect or establish the cause of the zero-hit pattern. Finally, the fitted classifier requires labelled examples, and the comparisons omit training-fitted offsets, standalone nonlinear cross-entropy classifiers and encoder fine-tuning. In-sample offsets match the fitted readout’s aggregate score, so the design recommendations apply to the evaluated readouts and T5 configurations.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion

blocks.en: MEG2text improves non-invasive word decoding by addressing the full path from brain–text alignment to candidate ranking. The complete system reaches 64.12% mean Top-10 balanced accuracy on LibriBrain100, exceeding published MEG-XL by 16.92 percentage points with gains across all four corpora. Controlled comparisons establish improvements from correcting training and evaluation and from fitting a class-balanced readout to the same aligned features. Word-level analysis shows why the decoding rule matters: a candidate can distinguish its own events yet consistently lose to competing words. In this setting, similarity-based retrieval underestimates the word-decoding performance attainable from the aligned representation. Comparing it with a learned decision rule gives a more informative assessment of what these neural features support.
blocks.zh: MEG2text通过解决从大脑-文本对齐到候选人排名的全部路径,改进了非入侵词解码. 整个系统在LibriBrain100上达到64.12%的Top-10平衡精度,超过已公布的MEG-XL16.92个百分点,所有四个公司都有增益. 进行有控制的比较可以改进培训和评价的校正,使班级平衡的读取与同样的校正特征相一致。 词层分析显示解码规则为何重要:候选人可以区分自己的事件,但总是输给相竞词. 在这个设置中,基于相似性的检索低估了从对齐的表示中可以实现的词解码性能. 将它与一个学习到的决定规则相比较,可以更深入地评估这些神经特征支持什么.
